title: Res. Timor en Onderh – blad 91-92/XLV-XLVI

series.title: Res. Timor en Onderh.
series.notes: Topographic map series of Rote Island and West Timor showing roads, tracks, footpaths, boundaries, water features, vegetation, cultivation, swamps, buildings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | Includes index to adjoining sheets, and administrative index. | Later sheets published: Batavia : Topografische Dienst. | National Library of Australia's copy of sheet XLIX/L-87 is a colour planprint from a scan of the lithographed original. $5ANL

creator: Topografische Inrichting (Jakarta, Indonesia), cartographer. issuing body.
